title: Unable to load texture array file in ktx2 format

labels.name: A-Rendering
labels.description: Drawing game state to the screen

labels.name: A-Assets
labels.description: Load files from disk to use for things like images, models, and sounds

body:
## Bevy version

0.7.0

## Operating system & version

Manjaro

## What you did

- Generate a texture array file in ktx2 format with `basisu -ktx2 -uastc -tex_array a.png b.png`.
- Load it with `asset_server.load("c.ktx2")`.

## What you expected to happen

Should be loaded successfully.

## Additional information

When using `basisu -ktx2 -uastc -tex_array a.png` to generate a texture array which contains only 1 image, it can be loaded successfully. Also, the same images can be loaded using basis.

The ktx2 file used:
[stack.zip](https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/files/8499476/stack.zip)
